description: Tier-1 §4.11.1.2 5-seed expansion of A2.5 + A5b K=1 + A5b K=2 LOCKED canonical. Trains A2.5 honesty-prior heads for 2 additional seeds {999, 31337} and re-runs extended beta-sweep K=1 (G4_gi) + K=2 (G4_gi + G5_modulation) across all 5 seeds. Reports N=3 subset (paper-comparable to prior 3-seed locks) and N=5 (full new headline) aggregates with sigma reduction percentage. Verdict tests whether the +0.011 K=2 lift over K=1 holds at N=5 (~1.4 sigma at N=3).
